**Quick one‑screen plan for a basic booking app** | What we’re building | A simple booking system where people can log in, view a calendar of available slots, book a slot, and cancel their own booking. | |---------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | Who uses it? | Anyone who wants to book through the site. | | Risk level | **Amber** (personal data + bookings + payments). | | Day‑one features | 1. Email‑only magic‑link login. 2. View a calendar of free slots. 3. Book or cancel a slot. | | Information stored | Email address, booking date/time, payment status. (Personal but not sensitive data like health or finance.) | | Logins | Magic‑link (Supabase Auth). | | Money | Optional paid bookings via Stripe Checkout (free for version 1, but ready for future). | | Built with | **Supabase** (Auth, Postgres + Row Level Security, Storage + Functions) + **Next.js** (React framework with SSR). | | Steps | 1. Spin up a Supabase project, create `bookings` table with RLS, create a magic‑link login flow. 2. Add a Next.js page that fetches available slots and displays them. 3. Add “Book” button that calls a Supabase function to insert a row, protected by the user’s identity. 4. Add “Cancel” button that deletes the user’s own row. 5. (Optional) Add a Stripe Checkout route that starts a payment and writes a `paid` flag on success. | | Safety | • All keys live in Supabase secrets, never in the browser.
• RLS on `bookings` so each user only sees/changes their own rows.
• Magic‑link login limits credential exposure.
• Stripe webhook verifies payments before toggling `paid`.
• Save point before each step (Git commit or snapshot). | | Not in v1 | No user‑generated content uploads, no AI features, no public data browsing. | **Does this look right?** Reply `yes` to start building, or let me know what to tweak.
